caption: The drawing is composed of a square patch of textile-like design with a dark blue background and ivory or white motifs. In the top left quadrant, there are three identical circular, floral patterns arranged vertically along a band that contains short horizontal lines separating them; the left edge features a border of small dots. The top right quadrant is filled with a large, symmetrical floral and leafy medallion surrounded by smaller flowers and circular shapes, and bordered on two sides by a scalloped edge with dots inside each scallop. Along the lower left, there is an eagle with outstretched wings, clutching arrows and a decorative shield, with a tree branch beneath its feet and a group of stars above its head. A horizontal band of fence-like pattern supports three stylized trees in the lower right, each detailed with symmetrical branches and leaves, and separated by vertical fence posts. At the bottom left of the drawing, there is a rectangular label with the inscription "M. JANE COOPER JEFFERSON CO. N.Y. 1846." The entire design is rendered in only two colors: a dark blue for the background and white for all the motifs and patterns.
title: Tyler Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
